review.reviewedBy: Codex source, latest user answer and concrete state assertions review
review.rationale: 最新Q001确定怀生对当前对手随机施加一项弱化异常，完整限定弱化类池并保留独立2/3回合；当前对象不延期，只有未触发后真实场下队友99回复延期。

success.name: 4872全部17招有序编译和64种子基础、17招完整真实2059用招；第五1963原始[1]冗余仍保留
success.assertion: test('4872全部17招有序编译和64种子基础、17招完整真实2059用招；第五1963原始[1]冗余仍保留',()=>{for(const m of source.moves){const c=E.WIKI.effectsEngine.compileInstances(m.effectInstances,source.effects,m);assert.equal(c.issue,'');const s=make({move:m.id,soul:true});assert.deepEqual(s.moveDefinitions[key(m.id)].operations.map(x=>[x.effectId,x.index,x.params]),c.operations.map(x=>[x.effectId,x.index,x.params]));turn(s);assert.equal(s.fighters[0].soulState.skillUses[key(m.id)],1);require('./helpers/next50-base-probe.cjs').verify({...H,source:{...source,moves:[m]}});console.log('#4872 base '+m.id);}assert.deepEqual(require('../local-species.cjs').issues(source),[]);});

success.name: 4872/2415/2416携带被动每项延长1回合，无需释放且双携不互换形态，实际完整伤害54%边界与单携转态
success.assertion: test('4872/2415/2416携带被动每项延长1回合，无需释放且双携不互换形态，实际完整伤害54%边界与单携转态',()=>{for(const carry of[[],[29267],[29268],[29267,29268]])for(const damage of[4859,4860]){const s=make({move:20044,soul:true,loadout:load(carry)}),end=3+carry.length;assert.equal(s.fighters[0].soulState.lotus2059.meshEnd,end);for(let r=1;r<=end;r++)observe((e,c)=>{if(r===1&&e==='beforeUse'&&c.a.side===1)c.hurt(c.t,damage,'形态阈值真实固定伤害','fixed');},()=>turn(s));let want=damage<4860?'pale':'wrath';if(carry.length===1)want=carry[0]===29267?'wrath':'pale';assert.equal(s.fighters[0].soulState.lotus2059.form,want);assert.equal(s.fighters[0].soulState.lotus2059.receivedSettled,damage);for(const id of carry)assert.equal(s.fighters[0].pp[key(id)],1);}});

success.name: 4872百天浮世络按完整结算伤害含保1零损失记录，普通清回合不清命名形态；怀生当前对手目标已答并实际附加
success.assertion: test('4872百天浮世络按完整结算伤害含保1零损失记录，普通清回合不清命名形态；怀生当前对手目标已答并实际附加',()=>{const s=make({move:20044,soul:true,loadout:load([]),hp:200});timer(s,0,'致命保留',{hp:1});for(let r=1;r<=3;r++)observe((e,c)=>{if(r===1&&e==='beforeUse'&&c.a.side===1){c.hurt(c.t,5000,'保1完整结算','fixed');assert.equal(c.t.hp,1);c.clear(c.t);}},()=>turn(s));assert.equal(s.fighters[0].soulState.lotus2059.form,'wrath');assert.equal(s.fighters[0].soulState.lotus2059.receivedSettled,5000);assert.equal(s.fighters[0].soulState.lotus2059.receivedHpLoss,199);const p=make({move:20044,soul:true,loadout:load([])});for(let r=1;r<=3;r++)turn(p);assert.equal(p.fighters[0].soulState.lotus2059.form,'pale');turn(p);const result=p.fighters[0].soulState.lotus2059.paleEvents.at(-1);assert.equal(result.targetSide,1);assert.equal(result.results[0].applied,true);assert.ok(Object.keys(p.fighters[1].ailments).length>0);});

success.name: 4872百天浮世络真实免弱反弹且不消费次数免异，复制对方真实最高星特性保留自身与源版本
success.assertion: test('4872百天浮世络真实免弱反弹且不消费次数免异，复制对方真实最高星特性保留自身与源版本',()=>{const s=copyBattle('高热',{star:0,ownName:'坚硬'});assert.equal(s.fighters[0].build.characteristic.groupId,C.groups.find(x=>x.name==='坚硬').id);assert.equal(s.fighters[0].soulState.lotus2059.borrowedGroupId,C.groups.find(x=>x.name==='高热').id);s.fighters[0].counts.immune=2;observe((e,c)=>{if(e==='beforeUse'&&c.a.side===1){const before=c.t.stages.def;c.stage(c.t,-2,['def']);assert.equal(c.t.stages.def,before);assert.equal(c.ailment(c.t,'烧伤',c.a,false,false,2,{probabilityPercent:100}),false);}},()=>turn(s,20044));assert.equal(s.fighters[0].counts.immune,2);assert.equal(s.fighters[0].ailments['烧伤'],undefined);assert.ok(s.fighters[1].ailments['烧伤']);});

success.name: 4872拒赦真实必暴、伤害翻倍且以混沌结算，怀生光结算不改技能原类型
success.assertion: test('4872拒赦真实必暴、伤害翻倍且以混沌结算，怀生光结算不改技能原类型',()=>{for(const form of['pale','wrath']){const a=make({move:10629,index:-1,soul:true,loadout:[10629,20044,38273,29270,38275]}),b=make({move:10629,index:-1});a.fighters[0].soulState.lotus2059.form=form;a.fighters[1].type=b.fighters[1].type='光';let observed;observe((e,c)=>{if(e==='beforeDamage'&&c.a.side===0){observed={affinity:c.affinity,stab:c.stab,modifier:c.modifier,crit:c.crit};}},()=>turn(a));turn(b);assert.equal(a.moveDefinitions[key(10629)].type,'光');assert.equal(observed.affinity,E.typeEffectiveness(form==='pale'?'光':'混沌','光',a.typeChart));assert.equal(observed.stab,E.sameTypeBonus(form==='pale'?'光':'混沌',a.fighters[0].type,a.typeChart));assert.equal(observed.crit,form==='wrath');if(form==='wrath'){assert.equal(a.fighters[0].soulState.resolvedPriority.value,1);assert.ok(sum(a)>sum(b)*3.5);}}});

success.name: 4872复制五星火热和静电取消特殊物理限制，99%真实有成功失败；原生低星仍保留且状态时长与PP合法
success.assertion: test('4872复制五星火热和静电取消特殊物理限制，99%真实有成功失败；原生低星仍保留且状态时长与PP合法',()=>{for(const [name,kind,status]of[['火热','physical','烧伤'],['静电','special','麻痹'],['极寒','physical','冻伤'],['颤栗','special','害怕']]){const seen=new Set();for(let seed=1;seed<=256;seed++){const s=copyBattle(name,{kind,seed,star:0});turn(s);seen.add(!!s.fighters[1].ailments[status]);assert.equal(s.fighters[0].pp[key(s.auditMoveId)],39-(kind==='special'?5:0));assert.equal(s.fighters[0].build.characteristic.groupId,0);if(seen.size===2)break;}assert.equal(seen.size,2);}});

success.assertion: test('4872复制受击异常取消物理限定，受特殊攻击高热冰冷阴森带电均真实附给对手且免弱保护不抹掉特性',()=>{for(const [name,status]of[['高热','烧伤'],['冰冷','冻伤'],['阴森','害怕'],['带电','麻痹']]){const s=copyBattle(name,{kind:'status'});turn(s,20044,10716);assert.ok(s.fighters[1].ailments[status]);assert.equal(s.fighters[0].ailments[status],undefined);}});

success.name: 4872复制五种受特殊降级特性取消类型要求，敌物理攻击后真实降级；五种强化特性保留正确槽与五星幅度
success.assertion: test('4872复制五种受特殊降级特性取消类型要求，敌物理攻击后真实降级；五种强化特性保留正确槽与五星幅度',()=>{for(const [name,stat]of[['反抗','atk'],['反驳','def'],['忽略','spa'],['草率','spd'],['慌张','spe']]){const s=copyBattle(name,{kind:'status'});turn(s,20044,10127);assert.equal(s.fighters[1].stages[stat],-1);}for(const [name,stat]of[['反击','atk'],['抵抗','def'],['反攻','spa'],['坚韧','spd'],['借风','spe']]){const s=copyBattle(name,{kind:'status'});turn(s,20044,10127);assert.equal(s.fighters[0].stages[stat],stat==='def'?2:1);}});

success.name: 4872复制强攻强念取消物特限制，按真实五星定额附红；强袭精神按真实五星比例且类型放开
success.assertion: test('4872复制强攻强念取消物特限制，按真实五星定额附红；强袭精神按真实五星比例且类型放开',()=>{for(const [name,kind]of[['强攻','special'],['强念','physical'],['强袭','special'],['精神','physical']]){const a=copyBattle(name,{kind}),b=copyBattle(name,{kind});b.fighters[0].soulState.lotus2059.borrowedGroupId=0;turn(a);turn(b);const row=C.get(C.groups.find(g=>g.name===name).id,5);if(['强攻','强念'].includes(name)){const n=Number(row.description.match(/提高(\d+)点/)[1]);assert.equal(sum(a)-sum(b),n);}else{const f=1+Number(row.description.match(/([\d.]+)%/)[1])/100;assert.ok(sum(a)>=Math.floor(sum(b)*f));assert.ok(sum(a)<Math.ceil((sum(b)+1)*f));}}});

success.name: 4872复制坚硬/吸收/虚无/反弹真实改变HP或结算量，回血类与顽强触发使用真实五星参数
success.assertion: test('4872复制坚硬/吸收/虚无/反弹真实改变HP或结算量，回血类与顽强触发使用真实五星参数',()=>{for(const name of['坚硬','吸收','虚无','反弹']){const a=copyBattle(name,{kind:'status'}),b=copyBattle(name,{kind:'status'});b.fighters[0].soulState.lotus2059.borrowedGroupId=0;turn(a,20044,10127);turn(b,20044,10127);if(name==='反弹')assert.ok(sum(a,'fixed')>0);else assert.ok(sum(a,'attack',1)<sum(b,'attack',1));}const heal=copyBattle('回神',{kind:'status'});heal.fighters[0].hp=1000;turn(heal,20044,10127);assert.equal(heal.fighters[0].hp,9000);const endure=copyBattle('顽强',{kind:'status'});endure.fighters[0].hp=100;observe((e,c)=>{if(e==='beforeUse'&&c.a.side===1)c.hurt(c.t,9999,'真实致命红伤','attack');},()=>turn(endure));assert.ok(endure.fighters[0].hp>0);});

success.name: 4872复制吸血按真实完整技能红伤回复，瞬杀99%真实击败；乱舞仍按现有用户确认白板且到期撤销复制
success.assertion: test('4872复制吸血按真实完整技能红伤回复，瞬杀99%真实击败；乱舞仍按现有用户确认白板且到期撤销复制',()=>{const s=copyBattle('吸血');s.fighters[0].hp=1000;turn(s);assert.ok(s.fighters[0].hp>1000);const kill=copyBattle('瞬杀');turn(kill);assert.equal(kill.fighters[1].hp,0);const blank=copyBattle('乱舞'),base=copyBattle('乱舞');base.fighters[0].soulState.lotus2059.borrowedGroupId=0;turn(blank);turn(base);assert.equal(sum(blank),sum(base));assert.equal(blank.rng,base.rng);const exp=copyBattle('强攻',{kind:'special'});exp.fighters[0].soulState.lotus2059.meshEnd=1;turn(exp);assert.equal(exp.fighters[0].soulState.lotus2059.form,'pale');assert.equal(exp.fighters[0].soulState.lotus2059.borrowedGroupId,0);});

success.name: 4872复制元素增威仍限定系别，精准/回避/会心/免爆以最高星静态数值生效且不改原始配置
success.assertion: test('4872复制元素增威仍限定系别，精准/回避/会心/免爆以最高星静态数值生效且不改原始配置',()=>{const R=E.CHARACTERISTIC_RULES;for(const name of['精准','回避','会心','免爆','坚硬',...C.groups.filter(x=>/^[\u4e00-\u9fff]+$/.test(x.name)&&C.get(x.id,5)?.description?.includes('属性技能威力增加')).map(x=>x.name)]){const s=copyBattle(name),a=s.fighters[0],b=s.fighters[1],row=C.get(C.groups.find(x=>x.name===name).id,5),compiled=R.compile(row);assert.equal(b.build.characteristic.star,0);if(name==='精准')assert.equal(R.accuracyFactor(a,b),1+compiled.fraction);else if(name==='回避')assert.equal(R.accuracyFactor(b,a),1-compiled.fraction);else if(name==='会心')assert.equal(R.criticalOffset(a,b),compiled.fraction);else if(name==='免爆')assert.equal(R.criticalOffset(b,a),-compiled.fraction);else if(compiled.kind==='power'){const move=s.moveDefinitions[key(10157)];assert.equal(R.powerFactor(a,{...move,type:compiled.element},[compiled.element]),1+compiled.fraction);assert.equal(R.powerFactor(a,{...move,type:'普通'},['普通']),compiled.element==='普通'?1+compiled.fraction:1);}}});

success.name: 4872复制精准/回避与会心/免爆通过真实技能命中暴击产生状态差，必中与强制暴击不被覆盖
success.assertion: test('4872复制精准/回避与会心/免爆通过真实技能命中暴击产生状态差，必中与强制暴击不被覆盖',()=>{for(const name of['精准','回避','会心','免爆']){let changed=0;for(let seed=1;seed<=64;seed++){const a=copyBattle(name,{seed,kind:name==='精准'||name==='会心'?'physical':'status'}),b=copyBattle(name,{seed,kind:name==='精准'||name==='会心'?'physical':'status'});b.fighters[0].soulState.lotus2059.borrowedGroupId=0;for(const s of[a,b]){s.criticals=name==='会心'||name==='免爆';if(name==='精准'){delete s.fighters[0].effects['攻击必中'];s.fighters[0].stages.acc=-1;}if(name==='回避')delete s.fighters[1].effects['攻击必中'];}const crit=[];for(const s of[a,b]){let val;observe((e,c)=>{if(e==='afterAttack'&&c.a.side===(name==='免爆'?1:0))val=c.crit;},()=>turn(s,s.auditMoveId,name==='免爆'||name==='回避'?10127:20117));crit.push(val);}if(name==='精准'||name==='回避'){const side=name==='精准'?0:1,ar=sum(a,'attack',side)>0,br=sum(b,'attack',side)>0;if(name==='精准')assert.ok(!br||ar);else assert.ok(!ar||br);if(ar!==br)changed++;}else{if(name==='会心')assert.ok(!crit[1]||crit[0]);else assert.ok(!crit[0]||crit[1]);if(crit[0]!==crit[1])changed++;}}assert.ok(changed>0,name);}const a=copyBattle('免爆',{kind:'status'});timer(a,1,'必定暴击');let crit;observe((e,c)=>{if(e==='afterAttack'&&c.a.side===1)crit=c.crit;},()=>turn(a,20044,10127));assert.equal(crit,true);});

success.name: 4872复制十五种元素增威只在本精灵真实光招匹配时增威，其余系别不加成；原生特性与额外最高星独立保留
success.assertion: test('4872复制十五种元素增威只在本精灵真实光招匹配时增威，其余系别不加成；原生特性与额外最高星独立保留',()=>{const rows=C.rows.filter(r=>r.star===5&&r.effectId===28);assert.equal(rows.length,15);for(const row of rows){const a=copyBattle(row.name,{kind:'special'}),b=copyBattle(row.name,{kind:'special'});b.fighters[0].soulState.lotus2059.borrowedGroupId=0;const type=row.description.match(/^(.+)属性技能/)[1],bonus=Number(row.description.match(/增加([\d.]+)%/)[1])/100;if(type==='光')b.moveDefinitions[key(10629)].power*=1+bonus;turn(a);turn(b);assert.equal(sum(a),sum(b),row.name);assert.ok(sum(a)>0);}const own=copyBattle('坚硬',{kind:'status',ownName:'坚硬',star:0}),copyOnly=copyBattle('坚硬',{kind:'status',star:0});own.fighters[1].stats.atk=copyOnly.fighters[1].stats.atk=1000;turn(own,20044,10127);turn(copyOnly,20044,10127);assert.ok(sum(own,'attack',1)<sum(copyOnly,'attack',1));});

success.name: 4872已答怀生：实际用技能后只对当前敌随机附加一种完整弱化类池异常，独立2或3回合，未用不授，失败只登记场下99延期
success.assertion:
const names=new Set(),durations=new Set(),pool=require('../dist/status-pools.js').pool(undefined,{includeRestricted:true}).filter(row=>require('../dist/status-rules.js').isWeakening(row.name)).map(row=>row.name);assert.ok(pool.includes('束缚'));assert.ok(pool.includes('魇昧'));for(let i=1;i<=64;i++){const s=make({soul:true,move:20044,index:-1,seed:Math.imul(i,0x9e3779b1)>>>0});s.fighters[0].soulState.lotus2059.form='pale';observe((phase,c)=>{if(phase==='afterUse'&&c.a.side===0){const selected=c.a.soulState.lotus2059.paleEvents.at(-1).results[0];assert.equal(c.t.ailments[selected.name],c.round+selected.duration-1);assert.equal(c.a.ailments[selected.name],undefined);}},()=>turn(s));const e=s.fighters[0].soulState.lotus2059.paleEvents.at(-1);assert.equal(e.targetSide,1);assert.equal(e.results.length,1);assert.equal(e.results[0].applied,true);names.add(e.results[0].name);durations.add(e.results[0].duration);assert.ok(pool.includes(e.results[0].name));assert.deepEqual(s.fighters[0].ailments,{});}assert.ok(names.size>10);assert.deepEqual([...durations].sort(),[2,3]);
 for(const mode of['immune','control','potion','miss','invalid']){const s=make({soul:true,move:10629,index:-1,hp:1000,hit:mode!=='miss'});s.fighters[0].soulState.lotus2059.form='pale';if(mode==='immune')s.fighters[1].counts.immune=1;if(mode==='control')s.fighters[0].ailments['害怕']=3;if(mode==='miss')timer(s,0,'攻击必失');if(mode==='invalid')timer(s,0,'skillBlock');turn(s,mode==='potion'?null:10629);const n=s.fighters[0].soulState.lotus2059.paleEvents?.length??0;assert.equal(n,['control','potion'].includes(mode)?0:1);if(mode==='immune'){assert.equal(s.fighters[1].counts.immune,0);assert.equal(s.fighters[0].soulState.lotus2059.deferredPaleHeals[0].amount,99);assert.equal(s.fighters[0].hp,1000);}}

interaction.name: 4872复制吸血按真实完整技能红伤回复，瞬杀99%真实击败；乱舞仍按现有用户确认白板且到期撤销复制
interaction.assertion: test('4872复制吸血按真实完整技能红伤回复，瞬杀99%真实击败；乱舞仍按现有用户确认白板且到期撤销复制',()=>{const s=copyBattle('吸血');s.fighters[0].hp=1000;turn(s);assert.ok(s.fighters[0].hp>1000);const kill=copyBattle('瞬杀');turn(kill);assert.equal(kill.fighters[1].hp,0);const blank=copyBattle('乱舞'),base=copyBattle('乱舞');base.fighters[0].soulState.lotus2059.borrowedGroupId=0;turn(blank);turn(base);assert.equal(sum(blank),sum(base));assert.equal(blank.rng,base.rng);const exp=copyBattle('强攻',{kind:'special'});exp.fighters[0].soulState.lotus2059.meshEnd=1;turn(exp);assert.equal(exp.fighters[0].soulState.lotus2059.form,'pale');assert.equal(exp.fighters[0].soulState.lotus2059.borrowedGroupId,0);});

interaction.name: 4872复制元素增威仍限定系别，精准/回避/会心/免爆以最高星静态数值生效且不改原始配置
interaction.assertion: test('4872复制元素增威仍限定系别，精准/回避/会心/免爆以最高星静态数值生效且不改原始配置',()=>{const R=E.CHARACTERISTIC_RULES;for(const name of['精准','回避','会心','免爆','坚硬',...C.groups.filter(x=>/^[\u4e00-\u9fff]+$/.test(x.name)&&C.get(x.id,5)?.description?.includes('属性技能威力增加')).map(x=>x.name)]){const s=copyBattle(name),a=s.fighters[0],b=s.fighters[1],row=C.get(C.groups.find(x=>x.name===name).id,5),compiled=R.compile(row);assert.equal(b.build.characteristic.star,0);if(name==='精准')assert.equal(R.accuracyFactor(a,b),1+compiled.fraction);else if(name==='回避')assert.equal(R.accuracyFactor(b,a),1-compiled.fraction);else if(name==='会心')assert.equal(R.criticalOffset(a,b),compiled.fraction);else if(name==='免爆')assert.equal(R.criticalOffset(b,a),-compiled.fraction);else if(compiled.kind==='power'){const move=s.moveDefinitions[key(10157)];assert.equal(R.powerFactor(a,{...move,type:compiled.element},[compiled.element]),1+compiled.fraction);assert.equal(R.powerFactor(a,{...move,type:'普通'},['普通']),compiled.element==='普通'?1+compiled.fraction:1);}}});

interaction.name: 4872复制精准/回避与会心/免爆通过真实技能命中暴击产生状态差，必中与强制暴击不被覆盖
interaction.assertion: test('4872复制精准/回避与会心/免爆通过真实技能命中暴击产生状态差，必中与强制暴击不被覆盖',()=>{for(const name of['精准','回避','会心','免爆']){let changed=0;for(let seed=1;seed<=64;seed++){const a=copyBattle(name,{seed,kind:name==='精准'||name==='会心'?'physical':'status'}),b=copyBattle(name,{seed,kind:name==='精准'||name==='会心'?'physical':'status'});b.fighters[0].soulState.lotus2059.borrowedGroupId=0;for(const s of[a,b]){s.criticals=name==='会心'||name==='免爆';if(name==='精准'){delete s.fighters[0].effects['攻击必中'];s.fighters[0].stages.acc=-1;}if(name==='回避')delete s.fighters[1].effects['攻击必中'];}const crit=[];for(const s of[a,b]){let val;observe((e,c)=>{if(e==='afterAttack'&&c.a.side===(name==='免爆'?1:0))val=c.crit;},()=>turn(s,s.auditMoveId,name==='免爆'||name==='回避'?10127:20117));crit.push(val);}if(name==='精准'||name==='回避'){const side=name==='精准'?0:1,ar=sum(a,'attack',side)>0,br=sum(b,'attack',side)>0;if(name==='精准')assert.ok(!br||ar);else assert.ok(!ar||br);if(ar!==br)changed++;}else{if(name==='会心')assert.ok(!crit[1]||crit[0]);else assert.ok(!crit[0]||crit[1]);if(crit[0]!==crit[1])changed++;}}assert.ok(changed>0,name);}const a=copyBattle('免爆',{kind:'status'});timer(a,1,'必定暴击');let crit;observe((e,c)=>{if(e==='afterAttack'&&c.a.side===1)crit=c.crit;},()=>turn(a,20044,10127));assert.equal(crit,true);});

interaction.assertion: test('4872复制十五种元素增威只在本精灵真实光招匹配时增威，其余系别不加成；原生特性与额外最高星独立保留',()=>{const rows=C.rows.filter(r=>r.star===5&&r.effectId===28);assert.equal(rows.length,15);for(const row of rows){const a=copyBattle(row.name,{kind:'special'}),b=copyBattle(row.name,{kind:'special'});b.fighters[0].soulState.lotus2059.borrowedGroupId=0;const type=row.description.match(/^(.+)属性技能/)[1],bonus=Number(row.description.match(/增加([\d.]+)%/)[1])/100;if(type==='光')b.moveDefinitions[key(10629)].power*=1+bonus;turn(a);turn(b);assert.equal(sum(a),sum(b),row.name);assert.ok(sum(a)>0);}const own=copyBattle('坚硬',{kind:'status',ownName:'坚硬',star:0}),copyOnly=copyBattle('坚硬',{kind:'status',star:0});own.fighters[1].stats.atk=copyOnly.fighters[1].stats.atk=1000;turn(own,20044,10127);turn(copyOnly,20044,10127);assert.ok(sum(own,'attack',1)<sum(copyOnly,'attack',1));});

interaction.name: 4872已答怀生：实际用技能后只对当前敌随机附加一种完整弱化类池异常，独立2或3回合，未用不授，失败只登记场下99延期
interaction.assertion:
const names=new Set(),durations=new Set(),pool=require('../dist/status-pools.js').pool(undefined,{includeRestricted:true}).filter(row=>require('../dist/status-rules.js').isWeakening(row.name)).map(row=>row.name);assert.ok(pool.includes('束缚'));assert.ok(pool.includes('魇昧'));for(let i=1;i<=64;i++){const s=make({soul:true,move:20044,index:-1,seed:Math.imul(i,0x9e3779b1)>>>0});s.fighters[0].soulState.lotus2059.form='pale';observe((phase,c)=>{if(phase==='afterUse'&&c.a.side===0){const selected=c.a.soulState.lotus2059.paleEvents.at(-1).results[0];assert.equal(c.t.ailments[selected.name],c.round+selected.duration-1);assert.equal(c.a.ailments[selected.name],undefined);}},()=>turn(s));const e=s.fighters[0].soulState.lotus2059.paleEvents.at(-1);assert.equal(e.targetSide,1);assert.equal(e.results.length,1);assert.equal(e.results[0].applied,true);names.add(e.results[0].name);durations.add(e.results[0].duration);assert.ok(pool.includes(e.results[0].name));assert.deepEqual(s.fighters[0].ailments,{});}assert.ok(names.size>10);assert.deepEqual([...durations].sort(),[2,3]);
 for(const mode of['immune','control','potion','miss','invalid']){const s=make({soul:true,move:10629,index:-1,hp:1000,hit:mode!=='miss'});s.fighters[0].soulState.lotus2059.form='pale';if(mode==='immune')s.fighters[1].counts.immune=1;if(mode==='control')s.fighters[0].ailments['害怕']=3;if(mode==='miss')timer(s,0,'攻击必失');if(mode==='invalid')timer(s,0,'skillBlock');turn(s,mode==='potion'?null:10629);const n=s.fighters[0].soulState.lotus2059.paleEvents?.length??0;assert.equal(n,['control','potion'].includes(mode)?0:1);if(mode==='immune'){assert.equal(s.fighters[1].counts.immune,0);assert.equal(s.fighters[0].soulState.lotus2059.deferredPaleHeals[0].amount,99);assert.equal(s.fighters[0].hp,1000);}}

success.name: 4872/4/5/12/37真实基础防速特攻命中强化、双弱化、烧伤与低体翻威阈值
success.assertion: test('4872/4/5/12/37真实基础防速特攻命中强化、双弱化、烧伤与低体翻威阈值',()=>{for(const [move,side,values]of[[20044,0,{def:1}],[20744,0,{spe:2}],[25070,0,{spa:2,acc:2}],[24127,1,{spd:-1,acc:-1}],[19928,1,{def:-2,spe:-2}]]){const s=make({move});turn(s,move,null);for(const[k,v]of Object.entries(values))assert.equal(s.fighters[side].stages[k],v);}const burn=make({move:22020});turn(burn);assert.ok(burn.fighters[1].ailments['烧伤']);for(const hp of[4500,4499]){const a=make({...row(37),hp}),b=make({...row(37),index:-1,hp});turn(a);turn(b);if(hp===4500)assert.equal(sum(a),sum(b));else assert.ok(sum(a)>sum(b)*1.9);}});

success.name: 4872/4真实15%攻击强化存在成功失败、上限不溢出；440双耗PP到三回合结束后恢复，2414高红伤不回复
success.assertion: test('4872/4真实15%攻击强化存在成功失败、上限不溢出；440双耗PP到三回合结束后恢复，2414高红伤不回复',()=>{const seen=new Set();for(let seed=1;seed<=40;seed++){const s=make({move:14344,seed:Math.imul(seed,0x9e3779b1)>>>0});turn(s);seen.add(s.fighters[0].stages.atk);}assert.deepEqual(seen,new Set([0,1]));const s=make({...row(440),loadout:[24127,20044,29269,29270,38275]});for(let r=1;r<=4;r++){const before=s.fighters[1].pp[key(20117)];turn(s,r===1?24127:20044);assert.equal(before-s.fighters[1].pp[key(20117)],r<=3?2:1);}const high=make({...row(2414),hp:1000,aStats:{spa:1000}});turn(high);assert.ok(sum(high)>=99);assert.equal(high.fighters[0].hp,1000);});

success.assertion: test('4872/4/5/12/37真实基础防速特攻命中强化、双弱化、烧伤与低体翻威阈值',()=>{for(const [move,side,values]of[[20044,0,{def:1}],[20744,0,{spe:2}],[25070,0,{spa:2,acc:2}],[24127,1,{spd:-1,acc:-1}],[19928,1,{def:-2,spe:-2}]]){const s=make({move});turn(s,move,null);for(const[k,v]of Object.entries(values))assert.equal(s.fighters[side].stages[k],v);}const burn=make({move:22020});turn(burn);assert.ok(burn.fighters[1].ailments['烧伤']);for(const hp of[4500,4499]){const a=make({...row(37),hp}),b=make({...row(37),index:-1,hp});turn(a);turn(b);if(hp===4500)assert.equal(sum(a),sum(b));else assert.ok(sum(a)>sum(b)*1.9);}});

success.assertion: test('4872/4真实15%攻击强化存在成功失败、上限不溢出；440双耗PP到三回合结束后恢复，2414高红伤不回复',()=>{const seen=new Set();for(let seed=1;seed<=40;seed++){const s=make({move:14344,seed:Math.imul(seed,0x9e3779b1)>>>0});turn(s);seen.add(s.fighters[0].stages.atk);}assert.deepEqual(seen,new Set([0,1]));const s=make({...row(440),loadout:[24127,20044,29269,29270,38275]});for(let r=1;r<=4;r++){const before=s.fighters[1].pp[key(20117)];turn(s,r===1?24127:20044);assert.equal(before-s.fighters[1].pp[key(20117)],r<=3?2:1);}const high=make({...row(2414),hp:1000,aStats:{spa:1000}});turn(high);assert.ok(sum(high)>=99);assert.equal(high.fighters[0].hp,1000);});

success.assertion: test('4872/2413全部PP不满才全恢复并神游，扣费前其余有满则失败；2414按完整红伤99阈值恢复99%且禁疗阻技能回血',()=>{for(const all of[false,true]){const s=make(row(2413));if(all)s.fighters[0].moves.forEach(k=>s.fighters[0].pp[k]--);turn(s);assert.equal(!!s.fighters[1].ailments['神游'],all);if(all)for(const k of s.fighters[0].moves)assert.equal(s.fighters[0].pp[k],s.moveDefinitions[k].pp);}for(const ban of[false,true]){const s=make({...row(2414),hp:1});timer(s,1,'攻击伤害免疫');if(ban)timer(s,0,'技能禁疗');turn(s);assert.equal(sum(s),0);assert.equal(s.fighters[0].hp,ban?1:8911);}});

success.name: 4872/2059同源刷新到2而非累计，固定免疫不降低99理论回复，回合反弹优先不消耗次数；2413免异不重抽

success.assertion: test('4872全部17招有序编译和64种子基础、17招完整真实2059用招；第五1963原始[1]冗余仍保留',()=>{for(const m of source.moves){const c=E.WIKI.effectsEngine.compileInstances(m.effectInstances,source.effects,m);assert.equal(c.issue,'');const s=make({move:m.id,soul:true});assert.deepEqual(s.moveDefinitions[key(m.id)].operations.map(x=>[x.effectId,x.index,x.params]),c.operations.map(x=>[x.effectId,x.index,x.params]));turn(s);assert.equal(s.fighters[0].soulState.skillUses[key(m.id)],1);require('./helpers/next50-base-probe.cjs').verify({...H,source:{...source,moves:[m]}});console.log('#4872 base '+m.id);}assert.deepEqual(require('../local-species.cjs').issues(source),[]);});

success.name: 4872/2059实际两次免异同源刷新、异源反弹优先不消费，成功固定吸取99并按理论回复；1882真实下一只只登记延期
success.assertion: test('4872/2059实际两次免异同源刷新、异源反弹优先不消费，成功固定吸取99并按理论回复；1882真实下一只只登记延期',()=>{const s=make({...row(2059),hp:1000});turn(s);assert.equal(s.fighters[0].counts.immune,2);observe((e,c)=>{if(e==='beforeUse'&&c.a.side===1){assert.equal(c.ailment(c.t,'烧伤',c.a,false,false,2,{probabilityPercent:100}),false);assert.equal(c.t.counts.immune,1);assert.equal(c.t.hp,1099);}},()=>turn(s,29268));assert.equal(sum(s,'fixed'),99);const raw=make(row(1882));turn(raw);assert.equal(raw.fighters[0].counts.attackNullify,undefined);assert.equal(raw.fighters[0].ailments['砥砺'],undefined);});

success.assertion: test('4872/2059同源刷新到2而非累计，固定免疫不降低99理论回复，回合反弹优先不消耗次数；2413免异不重抽',()=>{const a=make({...row(2059),hp:1000});turn(a);turn(a);assert.equal(a.fighters[0].counts.immune,2);timer(a,1,'固定百分比免疫');observe((e,c)=>{if(e==='beforeUse'&&c.a.side===1){const hp=c.t.hp;c.ailment(c.t,'烧伤',c.a,false,false,2,{probabilityPercent:100});assert.equal(c.t.hp-hp,99);assert.equal(c.t.counts.immune,1);}},()=>turn(a,29268));assert.equal(sum(a,'fixed'),0);const b=make(row(2059));turn(b);timer(b,0,'reflect');observe((e,c)=>{if(e==='beforeUse'&&c.a.side===1)c.ailment(c.t,'烧伤',c.a,false,false,2,{probabilityPercent:100});},()=>turn(b,29268));assert.equal(b.fighters[0].counts.immune,2);assert.equal(sum(b,'fixed'),0);const p=make(row(2413));p.fighters[0].moves.forEach(k=>p.fighters[0].pp[k]--);p.fighters[1].counts.immune=1;turn(p);assert.equal(p.fighters[1].counts.immune,0);assert.equal(p.fighters[1].ailments['神游'],undefined);});

success.name: 4872/2409形态疲惫害怕，2408慈悲一次保1含完整伤害与威怒次回先制，来源无形态无授予
success.assertion: test('4872/2409形态疲惫害怕，2408慈悲一次保1含完整伤害与威怒次回先制，来源无形态无授予',()=>{for(const form of[null,'pale','wrath']){const a=make(row(2409));a.fighters[0].soulState.lotus2059={form};turn(a);assert.equal(!!a.fighters[1].ailments['疲惫'],form==='pale');assert.equal(!!a.fighters[1].ailments['害怕'],form==='wrath');const b=make(row(2408));b.fighters[0].soulState.lotus2059={form};turn(b);if(form==='pale'){b.fighters[0].hp=200;observe((e,c)=>{if(e==='beforeUse'&&c.a.side===1){c.hurt(c.t,800,'一次保1完整伤害','fixed');assert.equal(c.t.hp,1);assert.equal(c.t.soulState.nextLethalFloor,undefined);}},()=>turn(b,29268));assert.equal(b.damageEvents.filter(e=>e.type==='fixed'&&e.targetSide===0&&e.sourceSide===1).at(-1).settledDamage,800);}else{turn(b,29268);assert.equal(b.fighters[0].soulState.resolvedPriority.value,form==='wrath'?1:0);}}});

success.assertion: test('4872/2409形态疲惫害怕，2408慈悲一次保1含完整伤害与威怒次回先制，来源无形态无授予',()=>{for(const form of[null,'pale','wrath']){const a=make(row(2409));a.fighters[0].soulState.lotus2059={form};turn(a);assert.equal(!!a.fighters[1].ailments['疲惫'],form==='pale');assert.equal(!!a.fighters[1].ailments['害怕'],form==='wrath');const b=make(row(2408));b.fighters[0].soulState.lotus2059={form};turn(b);if(form==='pale'){b.fighters[0].hp=200;observe((e,c)=>{if(e==='beforeUse'&&c.a.side===1){c.hurt(c.t,800,'一次保1完整伤害','fixed');assert.equal(c.t.hp,1);assert.equal(c.t.soulState.nextLethalFloor,undefined);}},()=>turn(b,29268));assert.equal(b.damageEvents.filter(e=>e.type==='fixed'&&e.targetSide===0&&e.sourceSide===1).at(-1).settledDamage,800);}else{turn(b,29268);assert.equal(b.fighters[0].soulState.resolvedPriority.value,form==='wrath'?1:0);}}});

success.name: 4872/881弱化优先级+3、1524反馈成功满回复而免弱失败净自身，925满HP威力99%，1366完整红伤比例逐用33/66/99封顶
success.assertion: test('4872/881弱化优先级+3、1524反馈成功满回复而免弱失败净自身，925满HP威力99%，1366完整红伤比例逐用33/66/99封顶',()=>{const s=make(row(881));s.fighters[0].stages.def=-1;turn(s);assert.equal(s.fighters[0].soulState.resolvedPriority.value,3);for(const immune of[false,true]){const a=make({...row(1524),hp:1000});a.fighters[0].stages.def=-2;if(immune)timer(a,1,'免弱');turn(a,a.auditMoveId,null);assert.equal(a.fighters[0].stages.def,0);assert.equal(a.fighters[1].stages.def,immune?0:-2);assert.equal(a.fighters[0].hp,immune?1000:9000);}for(const hp of[9000,8999]){const a=make({...row(925),hp}),b=make({...row(925),index:-1,hp});turn(a);turn(b);if(hp===9000)assert.ok(sum(a)>sum(b)*1.9);else assert.equal(sum(a),sum(b));}const a=make(row(1366));for(const ratio of[.33,.66,.99,.99]){turn(a);assert.equal(sum(a,'percent'),Math.floor(sum(a)*ratio));}});

success.assertion: test('4872/2410公共异常转化保留最大剩余时长且不触发免异反弹，慈悲取得敌盾99%不取护罩，威怒当回合回复减99%',()=>{for(const form of['pale','wrath']){const s=make(row(2410));s.fighters[0].soulState.lotus2059={form};s.fighters[1].ailments={烧伤:4,麻痹:3};s.fighters[1].counts.immune=2;timer(s,1,'reflect');require('../dist/shield-rules.js').refresh(s.fighters[1],1000,'enemy-shield');require('../dist/shield-rules.js').refreshBarrier(s.fighters[1],500,'enemy-barrier');let checked=false;observe((e,c)=>{if(e==='afterAttack'&&c.a.side===0){assert.equal(c.t.ailments[form==='pale'?'疲惫':'害怕'],4);assert.equal(c.t.ailments['烧伤'],undefined);assert.equal(c.t.counts.immune,2);assert.equal(Object.keys(c.a.ailments).length,0);if(form==='pale')assert.equal(c.shieldValue(c.a),Math.floor(c.shieldValue(c.t)*.99));else assert.equal(c.t.effects['回复效果削减'].fraction,.99);checked=true;}},()=>turn(s));assert.equal(checked,true);}});

assert.equal(has(source),false);for(const change of[s=>s.source.revision='00000000',s=>s.moves.find(m=>m.id===38275).hash='00000000',s=>s.effects.find(e=>e.id===1963).revision='seerapi:00000000',s=>s.moves.find(m=>m.id===38275).effectInstances[3].args[0]=2]){const bad=structuredClone(source);change(bad);assert.equal(has(bad),true);}assert.equal(has(source,require('path').join(process.cwd(),'research/BATCH-4816-REMAINING/4872')),true);
 const original=source.moves.find(m=>m.id===38275),bad=structuredClone(original);bad.effectInstances[3].args=[];assert.notEqual(E.WIKI.effectsEngine.compileInstances(bad.effectInstances,source.effects,bad).issue,'');

interaction.name: 4872全部17招有序编译和64种子基础、17招完整真实2059用招；第五1963原始[1]冗余仍保留
interaction.assertion: test('4872全部17招有序编译和64种子基础、17招完整真实2059用招；第五1963原始[1]冗余仍保留',()=>{for(const m of source.moves){const c=E.WIKI.effectsEngine.compileInstances(m.effectInstances,source.effects,m);assert.equal(c.issue,'');const s=make({move:m.id,soul:true});assert.deepEqual(s.moveDefinitions[key(m.id)].operations.map(x=>[x.effectId,x.index,x.params]),c.operations.map(x=>[x.effectId,x.index,x.params]));turn(s);assert.equal(s.fighters[0].soulState.skillUses[key(m.id)],1);require('./helpers/next50-base-probe.cjs').verify({...H,source:{...source,moves:[m]}});console.log('#4872 base '+m.id);}assert.deepEqual(require('../local-species.cjs').issues(source),[]);});

interaction.name: 4872入口真实4822易燃反弹、不提前跑回合或形态结束，源hash与待答1963参数不接受篡改
interaction.assertion: test('4872入口真实4822易燃反弹、不提前跑回合或形态结束，源hash与待答1963参数不接受篡改',()=>{const other=require('../data/species/4822.json'),b=structuredClone(other.snapshot??other),a=structuredClone(source),ids=[...b.moves.filter(x=>!x.fifth).slice(0,4),b.moves.find(x=>x.fifth)].map(x=>x.id),s=E.createBattle({wikiSnapshots:[a,b],wikiLoadouts:[[20044,38273,29269,29270,38275],ids]});assert.equal(s.fighters[0].ailments['易燃'],undefined);assert.equal(s.fighters[0].soulState.lotus2059.meshEnd,3);assert.ok(s.entryStatusEvents.some(e=>e.reason==='lotus2059-mesh-reflection'));for(const args of[[],[2],[1,1]]){const copy=structuredClone(source),m=copy.moves.find(x=>x.id===38275);m.effectInstances[3].args=args;const c=E.WIKI.effectsEngine.compileInstances(m.effectInstances,copy.effects,m);assert.ok(c.issue);}const bad=structuredClone(source);bad.souls[0].hash='bad';assert.ok(E.WIKI.assess(bad,[20044,38273,29269,29270,38275]).issues.length);});

interaction.name: 4872/1962第五未KO清对手回合类，保护及KO不清；1963原参数按最新确认冗余并执行未KO清强
interaction.assertion: test('4872/1962第五未KO清对手回合类，保护及KO不清；1963原参数按最新确认冗余并执行未KO清强',()=>{for(const mode of['alive','protect','ko']){const s=make({...row(1962),targetHp:mode==='ko'?1:9000});if(mode==='protect')timer(s,1,'protect');turn(s);assert.equal(s.fighters[1].effects['攻击必中']===undefined,mode==='alive');}const s=make(row(1963));assert.deepEqual(s.moveDefinitions[key(38275)].operations[0].params,[1]);s.fighters[1].stages.def=2;turn(s);assert.equal(s.fighters[1].stages.def,0);assert.equal(s.fighters[0].pp[key(38275)],8);});

interaction.name: 4872已答1963：原始[1]冗余不改来源，未击败清强，保护失败不清，KO不清，已命中零红仍清强
interaction.assertion: for(const mode of['alive','protect','ko','zero']){const s=make({move:38275,index:3,targetHp:mode==='ko'?1:9000});s.fighters[1].stages.def=2;if(mode==='protect')timer(s,1,'强化保护');if(mode==='zero')timer(s,1,'攻击伤害免疫');assert.deepEqual(s.moveDefinitions[key(38275)].operations[0].params,[1]);turn(s);assert.equal(s.fighters[1].stages.def,['protect','ko'].includes(mode)?2:0);assert.equal(s.fighters[0].pp[key(38275)],8);}
